description.value: Ox Eats Grass is a fully vegan food truck on Salt Spring Island run by a chef duo whose comfort-food-forward menu is rooted in animal welfare and environmental values. Beyond the truck, they've constructed a covered Greenhouse for year-round seating and host community events including open mic nights, ticketed dinners, and craft circles. A touring cyclist will find a warm, community-minded stop with online ordering and pickup available.

address.value: 189 Beddis Road, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2J2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ox Eats Grass is an active vegan food truck at 189 Beddis Rd, Salt Spring Island, BC, with events listed into February 2026 indicating the business is open. OSM diet:vegan=yes is strongly corroborated throughout the website's philosophy and food offering; a gluten-free option is mentioned in the Galentine's Doughnut Drop post. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null. The OSM community field says 'Duncan' but the business is clearly on Salt Spring Island — a notable geographic discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Duncan' but the business is located on Salt Spring Island — a separate municipality on a different island entirely. The OSM record may be geocoded or attributed to the wrong community.
No phone number is available in OSM or on the website; only an email (oxeatsgrass@shaw.ca) is provided on the Mutual Aid page.

Website notes that chef Jamie is departing at end of summer 2025 to pursue contracting full-time, with the business described as undergoing reinvention — worth monitoring for continuity of operations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active vegan food truck on Salt Spring Island with confirmed address, online ordering, and current 2026 events. A clear and useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email found on website (not in OSM): oxeatsgrass@shaw.ca. Instagram handle in OSM: ox_eats_grass.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Fully vegan menu confirmed throughout website. At least one gluten-free option noted for Galentine's Day Doughnut Drop: 'We will have at least one GF option as well!'
